definitions.full: H1191. Baalath בַּעֲלָת proper name, of a location Josh 19:44 ; 1Kin 9:18 ; 2Chr 8:6 , a city of Dan, possibly Bel`aîn Survey ii. 296 .

occurrences.englishText: and Baalath, and all the storage cities that Solomon had, and all the cities for his chariots, the cities for his horsemen, and all that Solomon desired to build for his pleasure in Jerusalem, in Lebanon, and in all the land of his dominion.
